recentItems.title: Mike Tomlin on Objectively Commentating on the Steelers
recentItems.description:
"I don't know that I am!" Mike Tomlin shares whether he'll be able to objectively commentate on the Steelers in his new role as an NBC Sports studio analyst for "Football in America."

Listen to Tomlin's episode of "Glass Half Full" wherever you get your podcasts.

recentItems.title: What Would Bunnie XO's Younger Self Think Of Her Today?
recentItems.description:
Bunnie XO left home at 14 vowing "never ... to allow myself to ever not be happy again." Now a successful podcaster and New York Times bestselling memoirist, Bunnie shared with Jenna Bush Hager on the Open Book with Jenna podcast what her younger self would think of her now.

You can stream the full episode of the Open Book with Jenna podcast with guest Bunnie XO wherever you get your podcasts.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Astronaut Victor Glover on Achieving Astronaut Emeritus Status
recentItems.description:
Astronaut Victor Glover was part of the elite crew on the historic Artemis II mission and now, he is officially taking a step back and retiring as an active astronaut. Glover reveals that he is taking on a new role as astronaut emeritus. “Making space, making room for my colleagues to go out and do big things while I sit in a support role… that’s something that’s really important to me.” he says. Glover also talks about his new role at Cal Poly, and how he is looking forward to spending more time with his kids.

recentItems.description:
Liam Neeson and Zachary Levi stop by TODAY to talk about their new action thriller “The Fix.” Levi talks about executive producing the film and starring in something different than his past projects. “It was awesome to be able to spread my wings a little bit,” he says. Neeson talks about the post traumatic stress of working in special forces, saying “These guys have had to do things, extraordinary things, to keep us all alive.”

recentItems.title: Hasan Minhaj, Maitreyi Ramakrishnan Talk ‘Best of the Best’ Movie
recentItems.description:
Maitreyi Ramakrishnan and Hasan Minhaj join TODAY to talk about their new Netflix movie “Best of the Best.” Maitreyi jokes about her “nonexistent” dance experience going into the project, and her four-month-long Bollywood training process. “I’ve never been more fit in my life, I didn’t like to sweat before this.” Hasan shares what drew him to the project and reveals his favorite part of the experience. “Seeing this young, incredible cast step into their own. This world means so much to so many people around the country.”
